analysis.scope_summary: NSWC IHD requires Secured Web Fingerprint Transmission (SWFT) fingerprint collection services for personnel requiring background investigations. The contractor must provide electronic fingerprint capture using Live Scan equipment at existing locations nationwide. Services include web-based scheduling system, FD-258 processing, and electronic fingerprint transmissions compliant with OPM standards. The contractor must process up to 900 personnel per year with less than 2% rejection rate.
